hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.dart) out=$(flutter analyze --no-pub --no-congratulate "$f" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: Running flutter analyze on edited file...

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; norm=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr '\\' '/'); case "$norm" in */android/local.properties|*/android/key.properties|*/android/*.keystore|*/docs/private/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: local signing config or a gitignored private record (see docs/android-signing.md / docs/store-publishing.md). Edit manually outside Claude Code if intentional."}}';; esac; }
